text: the Python expression 2 ^ n, i.e. bitwise XOR of 2 and n
for p = 0 the call fails with an exception, as Python's 2 ** n % 0 raises ZeroDivisionError

the docstring examples govern: modp(3, 5) is 5, modp(1101, 101) is 101, modp(0, 101) is 101, modp(3, 11) is 11 and modp(100, 101) is 101, so the formula does not describe the intended result (at least on those calls)
